name: Mount Gemm
title: Mount Gemm
summary: Northernmost of the three Mount Alphus table mountains in this batch, with portals to Mount Bellig and Mount Dalt (acpedia). In the kit: a flat summit (~125 x 150 m) at z 224 rising sheer 110 m above the plain, the North Dalt portal on its south-west corner, the South Bellig portal on the north-east, and an Empyrean hall at its north foot. Landblocks east (0x9391-0x9393) and south-east (0x9191, 0x9291) are missing; the camera works from the south-west.

landmarks.name: Empyrean hall at the north foot

site.name: Mount Gemm
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer south-gemm (summit plateau, south-west corner, 3 m from the North Dalt portal). [critic b4-7 2026-10-15: teleport changed from '@teleloc 0x91930009 31.3 3.4 224 0.866025 0 0 -0.5' because the gazetteer drop was 4.0 m from the North Dalt portal (weenieType Portal). Derived drop 12 m north-east on flat summit ground (224.0, level within 1 m for 12 m around), 15.3 m from the portal, 13.7 m from any drawn object. Cell index = floor(lx/24)*8+floor(ly/24)+1, z = ground + 0.5.]

shots.standingOrder: Hang 240 m south-west of Mount Gemm level with its summit, drifting 10 degrees and easing in as the sheer sunlit pillar rises 110 m out of the plain; nothing within 100 m, creatures may be faded.
